title: Normalization induction for the ordered affine coordinate tower
statement:
Fix the finite datum of [def-pur-conventions]: $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$, $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}k$, $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ finite with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$ and uniformizer $\varpi_E$, $n\geq1$, and $A=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$. All bases below are separated finite-type $k$-schemes [def-weil-finite-type-morphism, def-weil-proper-morphism]. Use the specified pro-etale Tate twists [def-coefficient-twists-detailed], constructible exceptional inverse image [def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image], and adjunction-preserving composition comparisons [def-weil-pbc-composite-adjunction, def-weil-pbc-adjunction-conjugate].

Let $B$ be such a base and fix $c\geq0$. For $0\leq r\leq c$ put $X_r=\mathbf A^r_B$, $p_r:X_r\to B$, $z_r:B\hookrightarrow X_r$, and $W_r=A_{X_r}(r)[2r]$ [def-sbc-affine-space]. For $r<c$ let $q_r:X_{r+1}\to X_r$ and $s_r:X_r\hookrightarrow X_{r+1}$ forget and set to zero the last coordinate, respectively. Use the actual ordered comparisons $\gamma_r=\gamma_{p_r,A_B}:W_r\to Rp_r^!A_B$ of [def-pur-affine-space-comparison]. Suppose each affine-line comparison $\gamma_{q_r,-}$ of [def-pur-affine-line-purity-comparison] is natural and invertible on bounded constructible finite-Tor inputs. Suppose given morphisms $u_r:W_r\to Rs_r^!W_{r+1}$ such that
$$\bigl(Rs_r^!Rq_r^!W_r\xrightarrow{\sim}W_r\bigr)\circ Rs_r^!\gamma_{q_r,W_r}\circ u_r=1_{W_r}.$$
Define $\theta_0=1$ and $\theta_{r+1}=d_r^{-1}\circ Rz_r^!(u_r)\circ\theta_r$, where $d_r:Rz_{r+1}^!\cong Rz_r^!Rs_r^!$ is the adjunction-preserving closed composition comparison. Put
$$b_r=\bigl(Rz_r^!Rp_r^!A_B\xrightarrow{\sim}A_B\bigr)\circ Rz_r^!\gamma_r.$$
Then every $\gamma_r$ is invertible, its target has the bounded constructible finite-Tor witness $W_r$, and the identities of actual morphisms are
$$b_0\theta_0=1,\qquad b_{r+1}\theta_{r+1}=b_r\theta_r\quad(0\leq r<c).$$
All comparisons in these identities are the conjugates of the same coherent compact-support compositors; in particular $b_c\theta_c=1$. The iterated comparisons use no purity assertion for arbitrary smooth maps.

Let $C_c:z_{c*}A_B\to W_c$ be the adjunct of $\theta_c$, using properness of the closed immersion, and let $a_c:Rp_{c!}W_c\to A_B$ be the adjunct of $\gamma_c$. Under the identity-normalized comparison $Rp_{c!}z_{c*}A_B\cong A_B$, the transpose identity is
$$a_c\circ Rp_{c!}(C_c)=1_{A_B}.$$
If every $u_r$ is invertible, then every $\theta_r$ is invertible and $b_r=\theta_r^{-1}$. In dimension zero all these formulas are identity formulas.
